description:
TLS for tls_mode='letsencrypt' ONLY: obtain a Let's Encrypt cert on the origin
    via certbot (nginx plugin) and arm auto-renewal (certbot.timer). For cf_flexible /
    cf_strict / manual this is a no-op (Cloudflare or the operator handles TLS) - use
    origin_cert_setup for cf_strict.
name: tls_setup
